name: bu_Mg2Al4O8
title: MgAl2O4 spinel (Mg2Al4O8) crystal
description: Variable-cell crystal-structure prediction of the spinel MgAl2O4 with two formula units (14 atoms, the fcc primitive cell of spinel) per cell. Experimental ground state: normal spinel (Fd-3m; Mg tetrahedral, Al octahedral); inverse cation orderings and MgO + Al2O3 (corundum) compete. NEP89 caveat: the inverse spinel (Al tetrahedral, Mg + Al octahedral) is 62 meV/atom below normal spinel, which is even 49 meV/atom above MgO + Al2O3, so the NEP89 global minimum is the inverse spinel.
